claims.evidence: The witness report identifies three domestic portable machines (Riccar, Semco, Novamatic), not industrial units.
Photo 0 shows a sample of decorative stitches, confirming multi-purpose functionality.
The items are identified as sewing machines.

risks.risk: Missing foot pedals and power cables
risks.proof: A photo showing all three machines connected to their respective pedals and cables.

risks.risk: Motor failure or internal mechanical seizure
risks.proof: A video showing each machine running and needle bars moving under power.

risks.risk: Timing issues or inability to form stitches
risks.proof: A video of each machine successfully sewing a line of stitches on fabric.

proof_requests: Video of all three machines powered on and sewing through fabric.
Photos of the foot pedals and power cords for each specific model.
Clear photos of the underside/shuttle area of each machine to check for rust or damage.
response.reason: The seller claims to be selling a single industrial machine, but the witness report shows three different domestic machines. This fundamental mismatch in type and quantity is a major red flag.
